ops.grounding: .agent-work/staged-feedback/627-unified-basis/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md 2026-07-18 627: Agent-tool harness has no headless claude CLI; all 10 crew dispatches used run_crew.py --backend external + --verify-result, the sanctioned records-only path.

ops.statement: In a headless/delegated run, arming a fire-and-forget BACKGROUND watcher and ending the turn to 'wait' reads to the Admiral as IDLE and stalls the run between steps (the Admiral nudged 3x this run). For a medium wait (a crew rework, a re-review, a slow-but-finite check) prefer a BOUNDED FOREGROUND in-turn poll (a foreground bash until-loop with a deadline that returns the moment the signal fires) so the turn stays alive; reserve OS-level detach + a single completion-notify only for genuinely-long (>~10min) jobs, and even then verify-alive rather than trusting the notify.
ops.bank_reason: The right boundary between 'foreground bounded poll' and 'detach + completion-notify' is contention- and job-length-dependent; re-observe across runs to calibrate the wall-clock threshold and whether the harness's completion notifications are reliable enough to depend on.
